preservation.formulas: Signed delta median/MAD; sigma=1.4826*MAD and noise band3*sigma. Thresholds0, noise factors[.25,.5,1,1.5,2,3,4,6], delta quantiles[.25,.5,.75,.9,.95]. First point retained; emit threshold0 OR absolute difference from last retained>=threshold. Reduction=1-retained/sampleCount; redundant/unchanged denominator=sampleCount-1. Noise/material classify adjacent delta. Fidelity=clamped1-RMSE/robustSpan(95-5 percentiles with fallback). Target=.9; score=.55 material+.35 fidelity+.1 reduction-2 suppression shortfall; smaller threshold tie-break.
